Thanks Tom — good questions. Looping in Dev (SE) for the technical detail and Grace for post-sales scope and timing. Stephanie from Legal is on copy for contract considerations.

Quick answers at a glance:
- Timeline: Sept/Oct is feasible for a single additional on-prem cluster; we typically allow 6–10 weeks for provisioning, network validation, and security review assuming access and approvals are available.
- Isolation: We support both approaches. Options: 1) Fully isolated on-prem cluster with no peering (air-gapped workflows) but limited cross-cluster syncing; 2) Peered VPC with strict ACLs and dedicated egress plus KMS integration for key separation. We should align on your security/compliance requirements.
- Cost: rough order-of-magnitude: +20–35% on top of current Private annual fee depending on size (GPU count, redundancy, DR options). Dev will follow up with precise pricing.

Dev — could you review and attach a recommended topology and an estimate for a 2-cluster setup (dedicated analytics cluster) with KMS integration?

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick scoping call (30 min) this week — please share 3 windows.
2) SE to provide topology + cost estimate.
3) Draft SOW & amendment for procurement/legal.

— Jordan

Hi Tom / Sara,

Attaching a preliminary topology and sizing recommendation. Key points:
- Architecture: Separate on-prem cluster for analytics (isolated control plane). Data exchange via controlled SFTP/Glue job triggers or explicit sync APIs; no default shared KV cache.
- Network: We recommend VPC peering with strict egress policies if you need occasional cross-cluster requests. For full air-gapped workflows we can disable peering and enable secure file-based transfers.
- KMS: Customer-managed keys (AWS KMS or HSM) supported for model artifacts and tokenization keys.
- Timeline: 8 weeks from signed amendment (2 weeks infra prep, 3 weeks provisioning & config, 3 weeks validation & DR testing).
- Estimated ARR uplift: +25% baseline for a standard analytics cluster (this includes 2x GPU nodes for redundancy). For heavier workloads we can scale.

I’ve attached the network_layout PNG and a draft SOW for reference. If procurement needs a line-item budget, Grace can provide a condensed quote.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
